refit: monthly expanding; fit rows strictly before first frozen-market observation in each test month
assignment: target-date t uses filtered state at latest frozen observation strictly before t (t-1 observation). No same-target close or future observation. Forward filtering only, never full-month Viterbi/smoothing.
state_order: Sort training-history posterior-weighted mean original Vol20 ascending; Low/Normal/High; relearned per market/month using training history only

bootstrap.method: circular date-block bootstrap over full test chronology; apply original regime mask after resampling; mean five seed BAs minus Persistence BA
bootstrap.ci: 95% percentile; require two classes and >=20 regime samples in resample

small_regime_flag: N<50 or minority-label count<10; CIs exploratory, no formal significance claims
best_selection: Read fixed cross_market_statistics/market_best_models.csv; never reselect using regimes
